name.value: Jin Soo Sung Chan Korean Restaurant

description.value: Jin Soo Sung Chan is an authentic Korean restaurant in Surrey's Guildford neighbourhood, serving a broad menu of traditional dishes including Korean BBQ, fried chicken in multiple preparations, hearty hot pots, and cold noodle soups. The kitchen emphasises made-to-order cooking from fresh ingredients, and the menu spans quick single-bowl meals through large-format shared hot pots. Online ordering is available for cyclists wanting a quick takeout stop.
